# Fixed linear regression power calculation: test R² = 0 vs R² ≠ 0
# Design: intercept + 3 predictors, n = 80, multiple correlation r = 0.30, alpha = 0.05

library(jsonlite)

# Input parameters
n <- 80                    # number of participants
p <- 3                     # number of predictors (excluding intercept)
r <- 0.30                  # anticipated multiple correlation coefficient
R2 <- r^2                  # R-squared (coefficient of determination)
alpha <- 0.05              # significance level (two-sided)

# Degrees of freedom
df1 <- p                           # numerator df (number of predictors)
df2 <- n - p - 1                   # denominator df (residual df)

# Noncentrality parameter for the F-distribution
# Formula: λ = (R²/(1-R²)) * ((n-p-1)/p)
lambda <- (R2 / (1 - R2)) * (df2 / df1)

# Critical F-value at alpha = 0.05
F_critical <- qf(1 - alpha, df1, df2)

# Power: P(F > F_critical | H1 is true)
# Use the noncentral F-distribution with noncentrality parameter lambda
power <- 1 - pf(F_critical, df1, df2, ncp = lambda)

# Output results
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

output <- list(results = list(results))

# Detailed computation log for verification
cat("=== Linear Regression R² Test Power Calculation ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Sample size (n):                %d participants\n", n))
cat(sprintf("Number of predictors (p):       %d\n", p))
cat(sprintf("Anticipated multiple correlation (r): %.4f\n", r))
cat(sprintf("Anticipated R²:                 %.4f\n", R2))
cat(sprintf("Significance level (α):         %.4f (two-sided)\n", alpha))
cat(sprintf("\nDegrees of freedom:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Numerator (df1):              %d\n", df1))
cat(sprintf("  Denominator (df2):            %d\n", df2))
cat(sprintf("\nNoncentrality parameter (λ):    %.6f\n", lambda))
cat(sprintf("Critical F-value (F_{%d,%d,α}): %.6f\n", df1, df2, F_critical))
cat(sprintf("\nPower = P(F > F_critical | λ): %.6f\n", power))

# Print JSON result
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(toJSON(output, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))
